Ladies and Gentlemen of the City Council,
This letter serves as our request for an extension of our“parked”winery license.
Due to unforeseen construction delays we have been moving forward to the best of our ability
and financial resources.After continued dialogue with the Building Department on public access
and accessible routes we are now in the process of adding a vertical porch lift (VPL) to the
facility tomeetADA requirements.
We are hopeful for project completion and the issuance for a Certificate of Occupancy for The
Blue Stem Wine House early this summer.
Respectfully,
Virginia Erdmann
